task_name: Unknown-Provenance Fail-Closed Allowlist & Immutable Evidence Contract Remediation

findings_remediated.title: Unknown pointing identifiers default to permissive non-blind evaluation
findings_remediated.mechanism: Centralized explicit calibration allowlist (CANONICAL_CALIBRATION_POINTING = 'P0008') in continuum_sidecar_interface.py. All unknown pointings (e.g. P9999), blind pointings (P0002, P0009, P0010), missing/empty IDs, and conflicting metadata fail closed to UNVERIFIABLE and color_excess_detected=False.

findings_remediated.title: ContinuumEvidenceRecord can be mutated after validation
findings_remediated.mechanism: Converted ContinuumEvidenceRecord to @dataclass(frozen=True) with deep-freezing of limitation_codes via ReadOnlyList and metadata/color_indices via ReadOnlyDict. Direct attribute mutation raises FrozenInstanceError, and in-place collection mutations raise TypeError.
